title: Your own names for private chats
changes: One-to-one chats show the other person’s name: you see Taylor; Taylor sees you.
Open Room info → Name and picture to choose a name only you see. Your label syncs privately between devices signed into your account. Use their name restores the default.
Group chat names stay shared. A group with only two people is still a group.
Includes the recent call layout, audio activity, Metadata and local attachment-cleaning improvements.
